from pathlib import Path
p=Path('test/api/fonts/clusterfuzz-testcase-minimized-hb-subset-get-codepoints-fuzzer-5973295416475648').read_bytes()
# parse sfnt
import struct
print(len(p), p[:4])
num=struct.unpack('>H',p[4:6])[0]; print('num',num)
for i in range(num):
 o=12+16*i; print(i,p[o:o+4],p[o+4:o+8].hex(),struct.unpack('>I',p[o+8:o+12])[0],struct.unpack('>I',p[o+12:o+16])[0])
# dump from offset 41 as cmap
base=41
print(p[base:base+80].hex())
print('cmap version,numtables', struct.unpack('>HH',p[base:base+4]))
for i in range(struct.unpack('>H',p[base+2:base+4])[0]):
 o=base+4+8*i
 if o+8<=len(p): print('enc',i,struct.unpack('>HHI',p[o:o+8]))
